Hi, I need your help with a compliance task urgently.

We have three corporate files from our Q3 2024 review sitting in the folder `/workspace/corporate_data/Q3_2024/`:
- `budget.xlsx` — the departmental budget spreadsheet
- `meeting_minutes.docx` — the executive strategy meeting notes
- `access_log.csv` — the system access audit log

I need you to read all three files and consolidate their contents into a single structured summary file called `consolidated_report.json`. The JSON should be organized so that the budget data, the meeting information, and the access log entries are clearly represented and easy to review.

Please save the output file somewhere inside `/workspace/`. Thank you!
